dateModifiedPolicy: Generated archive projections inherit the latest committed modification time of this canonical archive core. Production projections are generated only inside the immutable deployment artifact.

archive.name: BANHALMI ART
archive.role: Official artistic archive and evidence layer of Norbert Bánhalmi's oeuvre since 1999; not the canonical booking or pricing site.

professionalMirror.rule: Current professional services, pricing, team delivery, studio/office roles and service geography are authoritative on norbertbanhalmi.com. ART only carries a minimal role mirror and must not duplicate staff contact data.

geographyMirror.rule: Vienna and Budapest are the current professional studio markets. New York is a major international oeuvre/reference chapter, not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base. Detailed current location data belongs to the professional canonical machine core.

schemaPolicy.rule: The homepage ImageGallery schema is a representative discovery projection, not a full duplication of the archive image graph. Full image evidence remains in the image knowledge graph and archive records.

dataMinimisation.staffContactRule: Do not publish collaborator or relationship-specific email addresses in ART LLM entry points. Direct professional contact questions to the canonical professional site.
dataMinimisation.professionalDuplicationRule: Do not copy current professional prices, staff contacts or detailed office/studio facts into ART when the canonical professional machine endpoints can be referenced instead.
